results.identificationRemarks: High dorsal fin (taller than ones found in other jawfishes here), blue streaks rather than spots Description of species: ‘Dark grey body and all fins, a little lighter on belly; no obvious color inside mouth; upper tail membranes pale; female paler than male; 3 violet-blue lines along side and another along back just under base of dorsal fin, all reaching to tail; head with 2 blue stripes on side, a blue blotch at top rear corner of operculum, a blue line along top jaw; tail fin with thin blue bar at base and blue lines on membranes between fin rays; pelvic with blue front border; anal fin with blue outer edge and blue on membranes between rays.’ ,from here: https://biogeodb.stri.si.edu/sftep/en/thefishes/species/1185 Looks similar to this one: https://biogeodb.stri.si.edu/sftep/en/pages/random/1528
